name: Swelling Sea
text: Whenever you win your third trick with hearts in a round, this sigil gains +10 contract value.
timing: When you win any trick (the third heart win each round)

signature.trigger: you win your third heart trick in a round

decision: Whether to spend hearts early to reach three heart wins or hold them for the late tricks, and how many heart tricks to bid for.
opponent: The count is public; opponents can hold spades for the late hearts to deny a qualifying round.
aiNote: Value each round at three or more heart wins as +15 for the rest of the run; with Unfolding Butterfly, hold hearts for the last five tricks.
rationale: A Heart Chorus hand with Unfolding Butterfly wins three heart tricks in about 60% of rounds, so a copy bought around round 5 gives about +30 by round 10 and +40 to +50 by round 13, rare value for the thinnest archetype; the round that qualifies pays at once, and it grows across the run instead of paying a one-round bonus (Sunset Sailboat) or raising heart ranks (Unfolding Butterfly).
deviation: Rephrased from a count of qualifying rounds since purchase, capped at +90, to a sigil that grows each time it qualifies, without a cap.
